messages.author: e0169f921473cc94
messages.subject: Re: Skipping files that are too small for analysis or list object cannot be coerced to type doble
parts:
Adding to Lena's comments: It appears you are trying to process an ActiGraph 60-second epoch CSV file (i.e., not raw accelerometry data). Do you have the raw data (e.g., a .gt3x file)? Those are likely easier to get running through GGIR than your 60-second epoch file (observations based on personal experience).

To use the 60-second epoch CSV file you will need to look at additional configuration parameters such as:

data_format = "actigraph_csv"
extEpochData_timeformat = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S"
(likely others)

References:
  • https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIRParameters.html
  • https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/GGIR.pdf (search "actigraph_csv" to see example code snippets)
  • https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/tree/master/inst/testfiles (see ActiGraph CSV files as comparisons to your own files)
Best of luck!
